<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="第 1 页" id="H9Sdhd3rfHxJQjKeme-E"> <mxGraphModel dx="1078" dy="697" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "%%{init: {'theme': 'neutral'}}%%
classDiagram
direction TB

class ComponentActivity {
 <<Android>>
}

class MainActivity {
 -controller: GameController
 +onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?)
}

class UIScreens {
 <<Compose>>
 +RapidRecallApp(controller: GameController)
 +HomeScreen(onStart, onLog, onSummary)
 +LengthSelectScreen(onStartGame, onBack)
 +GameScreen(targetSequence: String, onSubmit)
 +ResultScreen(attempt: Attempt, onPlayAgain, onHome)
 +LogScreen(attempts: List~Attempt~, onBack)
 +SummaryScreen(summary: GameSummary, onBack)
}

class GameController {
 -repository: AttemptRepository
 -currentScreen: String
 -currentRound: GameRound?
 -lastAttempt: Attempt?
 +getCurrentScreen() String
 +getCurrentRound() GameRound?
 +getLastAttempt() Attempt?
 +getAttempts() List~Attempt~
 +getSummary() GameSummary
 +navigateTo(screen: String)
 +startGame(length: Int)
 +submitAnswer(input: String)
}

class GameRound {
 +sequenceLength: Int
 +targetSequence: String
 -generateSequence(length: Int) String
 +check(userInput: String) Attempt
}

class AttemptRepository {
 -_attempts: MutableList~Attempt~
 +addAttempt(attempt: Attempt)
 +getAttempts() List~Attempt~
 +getSummary() GameSummary
}

class Attempt {
 <<data>>
 +sequenceLength: Int
 +targetSequence: String
 +userInput: String
 +isCorrect: Boolean
 +timestamp: Long
}

class GameSummary {
 <<data>>
 +totalAttempts: Int
 +correctAttempts: Int
 +accuracy: Double
}

ComponentActivity <|-- MainActivity
MainActivity ..> UIScreens : hosts via setContent
MainActivity \"1\" --> \"1\" GameController : creates and uses
UIScreens ..> GameController : delegates user actions, reads state (via RapidRecallApp)
GameController \"1\" *-- \"1\" AttemptRepository : creates and owns
GameController \"1\" *-- \"0..1\" GameRound : creates and owns current round
GameController \"1\" --> \"0..1\" Attempt : last attempt
GameRound ..> Attempt : creates
AttemptRepository \"1\" *-- \"0..*\" Attempt : stores and owns
AttemptRepository ..> GameSummary : creates

note for MainActivity \"Entry point. Creates the single GameController<br>for the session and hosts the Compose UI.\"
note for UIScreens \"View layer. RapidRecallApp holds the controller,<br>reads its state and passes plain data + callbacks<br>to each screen. Screens report user actions through<br>callbacks (state hoisting). No game logic.\"
note for GameController \"MVC controller. Handles user actions: navigation,<br>starting rounds, checking answers, saving attempts.<br>Connects GameRound and AttemptRepository.\"
note for GameRound \"One round of play. Generates the random digit<br>sequence (String keeps leading zeros) and<br>checks the player's input. No Android dependency.\"
note for AttemptRepository \"In-memory session store of all attempts.<br>Private list, read-only view for others.<br>Computes the summary.\"
note for Attempt \"Immutable record of one completed attempt.<br>Timestamp stored as Long, formatted only in LogScreen.\"
note for GameSummary \"Immutable snapshot of session totals<br>and accuracy (0-100%).\"

reads its state and passes plain data + callbacks
to each screen. Screens report user actions through
callbacks (state hoisting). No game logic.
